_comment: Default rules for the send gate: truth and safety. Numbers need sources (claims), no statements about what the reader pays (cost_assertion_patterns), a few cliches banned, and a wide length band. House style (sign-off, a fixed closing line, a tighter length, bold and hyphen rules) is opt-in: setup --style example, or your own .gates/style.json. See docs/send-gate.md.
banned_phrases: I hope this finds you well

hubspot._comment: Optional. Used only by python -m gates.hubspot. Leave a property null to derive it from logged emails or skip it; the adapter warns which check that weakens.
